api_invalid_input: Something in that didn't look right. Check what you entered and try again.
api_internal_server_error: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again.
api_rate_limit_exceeded: Too many requests at once. Wait a moment, then try again.
api_not_found: We couldn't find that. It may have been removed.
api_unauthorized: You need to be signed in to do that. Sign in and try again.
api_file_too_large: That file is too large. Pick a smaller image.
api_unsupported_media_type: That file type isn't supported. Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
api_player_not_found: No player goes by that name. Check the spelling and try again.
api_invite_self: You can't invite yourself. Pick another player.
api_invite_exists: You already have an invite out to that player. Cancel it to send a new one.
api_not_your_turn: It isn't your turn yet. Wait for your opponent to move.
api_illegal_move: That move isn't legal. The board has been put back.
api_move_conflict: The game moved on while you were playing. The board has been refreshed.
network_unreachable: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
